title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Withdrawn Disputes and the One-Dispute Limit
content:
## Clause

An invoice line on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record may carry only one dispute, but a dispute that has been withdrawn does not use up that allowance. So when the sole earlier dispute on a line has been withdrawn, the line is open to a fresh dispute, as long as that dispute comes inside the dispute window.

## Cases

| Earlier disputes on the line | A new dispute on the same line |
|---|---|
| none | may be lodged within the window |
| one, withdrawn | may be lodged within the window |
| one, submitted | the line's single dispute is already taken |
| one, upheld, partially upheld or denied | the line's single dispute is already taken |

**Q: Is a withdrawn dispute counted when judging whether a line has already had its one dispute?**
No. A withdrawn dispute is left out of that count.
